title: Wanderlane Traveller Club: Schedule of Joining and Annual Fees
content:
Two charges are set against a tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club. The joining fee is the one-off amount payable to join at that tier directly rather than earn into it. The annual fee is the amount charged to hold the tier. Both are stated in US dollars.

## Schedule of charges

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Joining fee (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 495 | 1250 |
| Annual fee (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 295 | 795 |

## Direct entry and invitation

A tier is opened to direct entry only where the schedule below records direct entry as permitted for it. Where the schedule also records an invitation as required, the tier is granted on invitation.

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct entry permitted | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Invitation required | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |

## Reading of the schedule

Taken together, the two schedules give the following. At Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver, Wanderlane Gold and Wanderlane Platinum the joining fee and the annual fee both stand at 0 and direct entry is not permitted. Wanderlane Titanium is open to direct entry at a joining fee of 495 and an annual fee of 295, and asks no invitation. Wanderlane Ambassador is open to direct entry at a joining fee of 1250 and an annual fee of 795, and asks an invitation as well.
